div.head: VIII Atr 32
div.ab: And se cyngc beodeð eallum his gerefan on æghwilcere stowe, þæt ge þam abbodan æt eallum worldneodum beorgan, swa ge betst magon, ⁊ be þam þe ge willan Godes oððe minne freondscipe habban, filstan heora wícneran æghwar to rihte, þæt heo sylfe magan þe oftor on mynstrum fæste gewunian ⁊ regollice libban.

[32] Rex etiam edicit omnibus suis prepositis in omni loco per uniuersam gentem suam, quatinus abbatibus et omnibus ordinatis in omni seculari necessitate parcant, sicut melius potuerunt, et, ueluti Dei et meam amiciciam diligant, adiuuent eorum ministros ad rectitudinem, ut et ipsi firmius in monasterio diuino officio et regulariter uiuere queant.

And se cyngc beodeð eallum his gerefan on æghwilcere stowe, þæt ge þam abbodan æt eallum worldneodum beorgan swa ge betst magon, ⁊ be þam þe ge willan Godes oððe minne freondscipe habban, filstan heora wícneran æghwar to rihte, þæt heo sylfe magan þe oftor on mynstrum fæste gewunian ⁊ regollice libban.

And se cyngc beodeð eallum his gerefan on æghwilcere stowe þæt ge þam abbodan æt eallum worldneodum beorgan swa ge betst magon, and be þam þe ge willan Godes oððe minne freondscipe habban, filstan heora wicneran æghwar to rihte, þæt heo sylfe magan þe oftor on mynstrum fæste gewunian and regollice libban.

Und der König gebietet allen seinen Vögten an jedem Platze, dass ihr den Äbten bei allen weltlichen Nöthen Schutz gewähret, wie ihr bestens vermöget und, je nachdem ihr Gottes oder meine Freundschaft haben wollet, ihren Verwaltern überall zum Rechte verhelfet, damit jene [Äbte] selbst um so öfter fest in den Klöstern bleiben und kanonisch regelrecht leben können.

And the king commands all his reeves in every place that you protect the abbots in all their worldly needs as best you can, and, as you wish to have God's friendship or mine, help their stewards everywhere to their rights, so that those [abbots] themselves may more often stay firmly in their minsters and live according to the rule.

And the king enjoins upon all his reeves in every locality: you shall support the abbots in all their temporal needs as you best can, and if you desire to have God’s favour and mine, help their stewards everywhere to obtain their rights, so that they themselves may constantly remain secure in their monasteries and live according to their rule.

And the king commands all his reeves in every place, that you protect the abbots in all worldly needs as you best can, and, as you wish to have God’s friendship and mine, assist their stewards everywhere to obtain their rights, so that they themselves may the more often remain secure in their monasteries and live according to the rule.

And the king commands all of his reeves in every community to assist the abbots in all their worldly needs as best you can, and if you seek to obtain God’s friendship and mine, support their representatives everywhere in their legal interests, so that they themselves may, more often, remain secure in their monasteries and live by their rule.
div.note: The Consiliatio Cnuti inserts VIII Atr 32–34, I Cn 6 and VIII Atr 43–44 between II Cn 84.4 and 84.5 (Latin printed by Liebermann on pp. 267–268).; AU: corrected against Rabin p. 200 / 201, October 2026 (was “minnefreondscipe; filstanheora”, now “minne freondscipe; filstan heora”)

note.seg: Zwischen II Cnut 84, 4 u. 84, 5 schiebt Consiliatio Cnuti [vgl. oben S. 193] ein: VIII Atr. 32—34; I Cnut 6 und VIII Atr. 43; 44:
Between II Cnut 84, 4 and 84, 5 the Consiliatio Cnuti [cf. above p. 193] inserts: VIII Atr. 32—34; I Cnut 6 and VIII Atr. 43; 44:
Nicht nur Sheriffs, laut Cons., gegen Schmid 597b. Vgl. Gl Vogt 15a; Gnade 2—5; Abt 8; Adelsbeamte 1.—Die Cons. wählt für beorgan die hier nicht passende Übs. ‘schonen’
Not only sheriffs, according to Cons., contrary to Schmid 597b. Cf. Gl Vogt 15a; Gnade 2—5; Abt 8; Adelsbeamte 1.—For beorgan the Cons. chooses the rendering ‘spare’, which does not fit here
Cf. I As. Pre.; VI, 11; IV Edg. 1, 5.
